## About
From fender benders to big wrecks, Jeffrey's Collision Center gets your car, truck, or SUV back in shape. We're locally and family-owned, and our management team is right here on site to work with you from the first call to the day you pick up your keys.
Our technicians are master level ASE Certified and I-CAR certified, our shop is AAA approved, and we're a Gold Class collision repair business. That means ongoing training on new vehicle technology and on spotting hidden damage you might not see.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 61 Google reviews. Call or text us and we'll get back to you fast.

## Services
- Collision repair and auto body work: Repair and body work to get your vehicle back in shape after an accident.
- Frame straightening: We use current car aligners and frame straightening devices.
- Scratch and dent repairs: Fixes for the dents and scratches you're tired of looking at.
- Auto paint and cosmetic repairs: Paint and cosmetic work to bring back the finish on your vehicle.
- Headlight restoration: Clearer headlights on most vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call or text us to ask for a free estimate.

Q: How soon can I get an estimate?
A: In most cases, we can provide an estimate on the same day you ask.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We partner with most insurance companies to handle customer claims.

Q: Can you help me get my car towed in?
A: Yes. Tows are available 24/7.

Q: What do I do for a car while mine is in the shop?
A: We keep rental cars on site, and we're an Enterprise drop-off point.
